# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

This repository is maintained as an educational project for the **Reinforced
Concrete Design II** course. At this stage, updates are applied only to the
latest version available on the `main` branch.

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| main    | ✅        |
| older versions | ❌ |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability related to this repository (for
example, in the `repo__CORE_concreteII_desing` package or its dependencies),
please do not disclose it publicly at first.

Instead, please report it privately through GitHub Security Advisories for this
repository. Do not include exploit details in a public issue.

When reporting a vulnerability, please include:

- A clear description of the issue
- The affected file, module, or notebook
- Steps to reproduce the problem, if applicable
- Any suggestions that may help understand or mitigate the issue

You can expect an initial response within a reasonable time, depending on
availability during the academic semester.

Please note that this repository is primarily intended for educational purposes.
While reasonable efforts will be made to review and address valid security
concerns, no formal security support or guarantee is provided.
